gates.name: clean_starting_commit
gates.command: git rev-parse HEAD

gates.name: upstream_commits
gates.command: git -C external/Hermes-Agent rev-parse HEAD && git -C external/OpenMontage rev-parse HEAD

gates.name: no_upstream_modifications
gates.command: git diff -- external/

gates.name: source_compile
gates.command: python3 -m compileall src scripts bootstrap

gates.name: production_imports
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.orchestrator import StageOrchestrator; from acd_worker.hermes_runner import HermesRunner; from acd_worker.openmontage_runner import OpenMontageRunner; from acd_worker.quality_loop import LoopbackController'

gates.name: cli_startup
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/acd_worker.py --help

gates.name: canonical_stage_order
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.orchestrator import CANONICAL_STAGE_ORDER; print([s.value for s in CANONICAL_STAGE_ORDER])'

gates.name: real_stage_orchestrator
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.orchestrator import StageOrchestrator, FixtureArtifactProvider; print("Orchestrator with fixtures OK")'

gates.name: checkpoint_resume
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.orchestrator import CheckpointManager, ProjectState; import tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); m=CheckpointManager(d); s=ProjectState(project_id="t", run_id="r", user_request="t", created_at="", updated_at=""); m.save_state(s); l=m.load_state(); assert l.project_id=="t"; print("OK")'

gates.name: downstream_invalidation
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.orchestrator import CheckpointManager, ProjectState, StageName, CANONICAL_STAGE_ORDER; import tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); m=CheckpointManager(d); s=ProjectState(project_id="t", run_id="r", user_request="t", created_at="", updated_at=""); s.completed_stages=["request","story_understanding","footage_requirements"]; m.invalidate_downstream(s, StageName.FOOTAGE_REQUIREMENTS); assert "footage_discovery" not in s.completed_stages; print("OK")'

gates.name: targeted_loopback_execution
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.orchestrator import LoopbackController; c=LoopbackController(max_per_category=3, max_total=10); assert c.get_target_stage("invalid_timestamps") == c.LOOPBACK_MAP["invalid_timestamps"]; print("Loopback routing OK")'

gates.name: portable_configuration
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from scripts.acd_worker import ACDConfig; c=ACDConfig.from_env(); print(f"HERMES_HOME={c.hermes_home}"); print(f"OM_PROJECTS={c.openmontage_projects_dir}")'

gates.name: hermes_cli_contract
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.hermes_runner import HermesRunner; import os; r=HermesRunner(os.path.expanduser("~/.hermes"), dry_run=True); res=r.run_session("test", expected_skills=["football-story-strategy"]); assert res.success; print("Dry-run CLI OK")'

gates.name: hermes_live_smoke
gates.command: HERMES_HOME=~/.hermes hermes -p football-emotion chat -q 'test' -Q
gates.error_or_blocker: Requires valid LLM endpoint configured in Hermes profile; no free endpoint available in test environment

gates.name: openmontage_manifest
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from lib.pipeline_loader import load_pipeline; p=load_pipeline("documentary-montage"); print(f"Pipeline: {p["name"]}"); print(f"Stages: {[s["name"] for s in p["stages"]]}")'

gates.name: openmontage_tool_registry
gates.command: cd external/OpenMontage && .venv/bin/python -c 'from tools.tool_registry import registry; registry.discover(); import json; print(json.dumps(registry.provider_menu_summary(), indent=2))'

gates.name: native_schema_validation
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.orchestrator import ArtifactValidator; v=ArtifactValidator("external/OpenMontage/schemas/artifacts", strict_mode=True); ok,err=v.validate("edit_decisions",{"version":"1.0","cuts":[],"render_runtime":"ffmpeg"}); print(f"Valid: {ok}, Errors: {err}")'

gates.name: local_media_validation
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.source.acquisition import MediaValidator; v=MediaValidator(min_width=480, min_height=270); print("Validator OK")'

gates.name: synthetic_production_render
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src ACD_DRY_RUN=true python3 scripts/acd_worker.py --dry-run "Messi World Cup 2022 triumph 30s"

gates.name: render_report_measurements
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.openmontage_runner import OpenMontageRunner; from acd_worker.hermes_runner import HermesRunner; from pathlib import Path; import tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); r=HermesRunner(os.path.expanduser("~/.hermes"), dry_run=True); o=OpenMontageRunner(Path(d), r, Path("external/OpenMontage"), Path(d), {"render_runtime":"ffmpeg"}); print("Render report builder OK")'

gates.name: yt_dlp_discovery
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.source.discovery import DiscoveryEngine; e=DiscoveryEngine(); c=e.discover_for_slot("opening_pressure", ["Messi World Cup 2022 pressure"], "triumph", 3); print(f"Found {len(c)} candidates")'

gates.name: tavily_fallback
gates.command: TAVILY_API_KEY=test PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.source.fallback_discovery import create_fallback_discovery; f=create_fallback_discovery(); print(f"Tavily available: {f.tavily.is_available()}")'
gates.error_or_blocker: TAVILY_API_KEY not configured in test environment

gates.name: sequential_acquisition
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.source.acquisition import AcquisitionEngine; import tempfile; e=AcquisitionEngine(tempfile.mkdtemp(), max_attempts_per_slot=2); print("Engine OK")'

gates.name: replacement_flow
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from acd_worker.source.acquisition import FailureClassifier, FailureType; fc=FailureClassifier(); assert fc.classify("Video unavailable")==FailureType.REMOVED; assert fc.classify("Age restricted")==FailureType.AGE_RESTRICTED; assert fc.classify("403 Forbidden")==FailureType.PLAYBACK_BLOCKED; print("Classification OK")'

gates.name: fixture_end_to_end
gates.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/test_end_to_end.py

gates.name: live_end_to_end
gates.command: python3 scripts/acd_worker.py "Messi World Cup 2022 triumph 30s"
gates.error_or_blocker: Requires network, valid LLM endpoint, and downloadable YouTube sources (most World Cup footage is DRM-protected)

gates.name: secret_scan
gates.command: grep -r -E '(github_pat_|ghp_|sk-|gho_|ghu_|ghs_|ghr_)|DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL|TAVILY_API_KEY|HINDSIGHT_API_KEY' --include="*.py" --include="*.yaml" --include="*.json" --include="*.env" src scripts config bootstrap 2>/dev/null || echo "No secrets found"

gates.name: hindsight_persistence
gates.command: HERMES_HOME=~/.hermes hermes memory status
gates.error_or_blocker: Hindsight local_embedded requires daemon + local LLM (unavailable on Kaggle); local_external requires persistent free deployment (none available); cloud requires internet (blocked on Kaggle). Built-in MEMORY.md/USER.md + session search + project records work fully.
